sources.title: US Property & Casualty outlook: growth stalls as peak profitability fades
sources.captured: 2026-09-19, from the public abstract on the page (published 20 Jul 2026)
findings: The US P&C industry is entering a more competitive phase.
Underwriting margins are gradually compressing as rates decline across several lines.
Personal auto premiums fell year-on-year for the first time in decades outside a recession, while total P&C premium growth slowed to below 3% in 1Q26.

Headline profitability nevertheless remains exceptionally strong: lower catastrophe losses than a year earlier and stronger reserve releases contributed to the lowest first-quarter combined ratio since 2006.
